verdict.rationale: Fathom shows no native pre-meeting brief. The evidence only covers post-call building blocks: search across calls, a conversational meeting assistant, and Deal View summaries. A founder could manually query past meetings, or pull them into Claude or ChatGPT via the official MCP server or API, to assemble prep notes. Missing for 10: proactive pre-call brief tied to the calendar, automatic matching of past meetings by attendee, a rollup of open threads or action items before the call, and any hands-on corroboration.
